name: maskera-monorepo
description: Swedish-first, client-side PII redaction for AI apps

scripts.build: pnpm check:benchmarks && pnpm check:product && pnpm -r build
scripts.test: pnpm check:fresh && pnpm check:benchmarks && pnpm check:product && pnpm check:lint-ratchet && pnpm check:fixtures && pnpm check:training-privacy && pnpm check:tooling && pnpm -r test -- --sequence.shuffle
scripts.test:mcp:all: pnpm --filter @maskera/mcp build && pnpm --filter @maskera/mcp test && pnpm test:mcp:e2e && pnpm test:mcp:pack
scripts.eval:independent:maskera: node bench/independent/run-maskera.mjs tmp/indep/corpora/suc3-test-cased.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/suc3-test-lower.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/multiconer-sv.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/ai4privacy-sv.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/sic2-sv.jsonl
scripts.eval:independent:swedish-pii: node bench/independent/run-swedish-pii.mjs tmp/indep/corpora/suc3-test-cased.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/suc3-test-lower.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/multiconer-sv.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/ai4privacy-sv.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/sic2-sv.jsonl
scripts.eval:independent:python: bench/.venv/bin/python bench/independent/run_python_systems.py tmp/indep/corpora/suc3-test-cased.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/suc3-test-lower.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/multiconer-sv.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/ai4privacy-sv.jsonl tmp/indep/corpora/sic2-sv.jsonl
scripts.check:tooling: node --test bench/*.test.mjs bench/independent/*.test.mjs training/check_address_eval_leak.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/harness/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm check:fresh && for p in packages/core packages/ner packages/mcp apps/demo; do node node_modules/typescript-7/lib/tsc.js -p $p/tsconfig.json --noEmit || exit 1; done && node node_modules/typescript-7/lib/tsc.js -p packages/ner/tsconfig.runtime-test.json --noEmit
scripts.eval:kblab: cd training && MASKERA_COMPETITOR_ONLY=KBLab/bert-base-swedish-lowermix-reallysimple-ner MASKERA_COMPETITOR_MEASURED_AT=2026-11-25 MASKERA_COMPETITOR_RESULT_FILE=../docs/benchmark-kblab-v20.json uv run --python 3.11.15 --with-requirements benchmark-requirements.txt python benchmark_competitors.py
scripts.eval:logosguard:maskera: pnpm -C packages/core build && pnpm -C packages/ner build && node bench/run-maskera-domain.mjs
scripts.eval:domain: pnpm -C packages/core build && pnpm -C packages/ner build && pnpm -C packages/ner eval:domain
scripts.eval:domain:clinical: pnpm -C packages/core build && pnpm -C packages/ner build && MASKERA_PROFILE=clinical pnpm -C packages/ner eval:domain
scripts.eval:clinical-retention: pnpm -C packages/core build && pnpm -C packages/ner build && node packages/ner/eval/benchmark-clinical-retention.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm check:fresh && pnpm check:benchmarks && pnpm check:product && pnpm check:lint-ratchet && pnpm check:fixtures && pnpm check:training-privacy && biome check .
